game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing, a rope bridge over a pit: the spelunker must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing: a rope bridge over a pit
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Crossing, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round, zombies strike the rope bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from zombies in Lantern Crossing: keep the digits meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: digits drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Lantern Crossing.
